passage: Note for the home-science file, Thursday. Tanvir cooked onion pakoras for the class demonstration today. Before touching anything he washed his hands with soap and tied back his sleeves. He used one board for the raw onions and a clean plate for the fried pakoras, never mixing them. When the oil was heating he stood at the stove with his eyes on the pan and turned the handle inward. He did not leave the stove, even when a friend called him. He switched off the gas himself and let the oil cool before it went anywhere. I have asked him to help two classmates with their stove habits next week. Darshan, teacher

qa.q: Which food did Tanvir cook for the demonstration?
qa.a: Tanvir cooked onion pakoras for the class demonstration.

qa.q: What was Tanvir probably feeling when a friend called him and he stayed at the stove?
qa.a: He was probably focused and a little proud of his responsibility, choosing to stay with the hot oil instead of being distracted.

qa.q: What did Tanvir do to keep raw and cooked food apart?
qa.a: He used one board for the raw onions and a clean plate for the fried pakoras, never mixing them.

qa.q: How might Darshan see Tanvir's stove habits?
qa.a: Darshan sees careful habits that prevent burns and stomach trouble, which is why Tanvir is asked to help two classmates next week.

grounding: Shows a young cook washing hands, keeping raw and cooked food apart, watching hot oil and staying at the stove.

passage: Saturday. First time alone in the kitchen, Amma was out at a wedding. I made egg curry for my cousin Saurabh and me. I washed my hands, then washed them again after cracking the eggs. The knife for the onions and the raw-egg bowl went into the sink, and the salad got a fresh board. When the oil got hot, Saurabh begged me to let him try tadka. I said no, and turned the pan handle towards the wall. The gas stayed on the whole time and so did I. Not once did I go to the door. It felt a bit boring. Nothing burnt and nobody got a sore stomach. Chetan

qa.q: Who did Chetan make egg curry for?
qa.a: Chetan made egg curry for Saurabh and Chetan.

qa.q: What did Chetan feel when Saurabh begged to try the tadka?
qa.a: Chetan felt protective and firm, saying no and turning the pan handle to the wall, even though being so careful felt a bit boring.

qa.q: What safe habits did Chetan keep while the gas was on?
qa.a: Chetan stayed at the stove, kept the handle turned to the wall and never went to the door.

qa.q: How might Saurabh have felt when Chetan said no to the tadka?
qa.a: Saurabh was probably disappointed but safe, since hot oil is not something to try without care.

grounding: Shows a young cook washing hands, separating raw and cooked things, watching hot oil and never leaving the stove.
